source: Bilateral goods trade (exports + imports, merchandise only), US$ bn, latest full calendar year (2025 for 173 pairs; 2024 for RUS-IRN and the Iranian-year IRN-ARE/IRN-IRQ figures). Each row is read from one reporter's official statistics, cited per row in 'rowSources': US Census Bureau (US pairs), China General Administration of Customs (China pairs), Destatis (German pairs), Eurostat Comext (EU-reported pairs), HMRC (UK pairs), UN Comtrade (national customs filings of Japan, Korea, India, Canada, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Israel, Egypt, Malaysia, Kazakhstan), Taiwan Ministry of Finance, Iran IRICA, and official statements where no customs table exists (Russia-Belarus, Russia-Iran, Russia-Uzbekistan). Russia no longer publishes customs data, so Russian pairs use the partner's (mirror) figures. EUR/GBP/JPY converted at 2025 annual averages (ECB 1.1300 USD/EUR, 0.8568 GBP/EUR; Fed 149.57 JPY/USD).
notes: Each row: [nationA, nationB, two-way goods trade in US$ bn/year]. rowSources['A|B'] gives year, reporter, source and URL. Only IRN-IRQ is partly estimated (Iraq's exports to Iran estimated from a 10-month chamber-of-commerce figure) and carries estimate: true; every other row is sourced. Caveats: USA-CHE includes large gold flows; NLD/BEL pairs include port transit (Rotterdam/Antwerp effect); Saudi partner data omit most crude oil. Only the largest relationships are listed; trade outside these pairs is represented by the chokepoint dependence shares in data/chokepoints.json.
